note: Triennial election of Irvinestown Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was only one new member; the Belfast Telegraph names him, but the full list of unopposed returns is not printed. Added 6 Nov 2026: eight Unionist members re-selected for their divisions in the Impartial Reporter of 20 and 27 April and 4 May 1961; its nominations report of 18 May 1961 (p. 7) says there would be only one new member, so each was returned unopposed. Recorded for Nationalist-held divisions from the selection lists and first-meeting reports in the Fermanagh Herald: Aghamuldowney, Castlecaldwell, Garrison, Innishmacsaint, Irvinestown, Lattone and Belleek. Recorded from reports of the new council's meetings during the term: Milltown and Ederney. Returned unopposed.
